ROOT_DIR = "/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild"
PKG_PREFIX = "AlgebraicJacobian"
ROOT_MODULE = "AlgebraicJacobian"  # the root aggregator AlgebraicJacobian.lean maps to module name "AlgebraicJacobian"

import_re = re.compile(r'^\s*import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\s*$')

def module_name_for_path(path):
    # path relative to ROOT_DIR, e.g. AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Foo.lean -> AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Foo
    rel = os.path.relpath(path, ROOT_DIR)
    assert rel.endswith(".lean")
    rel = rel[:-len(".lean")]
    return rel.replace(os.sep, ".")

def path_for_module_name(mod):
    return os.path.join(ROOT_DIR, mod.replace(".", os.sep) + ".lean")

# collect all .lean files under AlgebraicJacobian/ (the directory) plus the root AlgebraicJacobian.lean file
all_files = []
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(os.path.join(ROOT_DIR, PKG_PREFIX)):
    for fn in filenames:
        if fn.endswith(".lean"):
            all_files.append(os.path.join(dirpath, fn))

root_file = os.path.join(ROOT_DIR, PKG_PREFIX + ".lean")
if os.path.isfile(root_file):
    all_files.append(root_file)

all_modules = set(module_name_for_path(p) for p in all_files)

# parse imports for each module
imports = {}  # module -> set of imported modules (only those within AlgebraicJacobian namespace, tracked regardless of whether target exists)
all_imports_seen = {}  # module -> list of ALL imports (for dangling detection, restricted to AlgebraicJacobian.* imports)

for p in all_files:
    mod = module_name_for_path(p)
    imps = []
    with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        for line in f:
            m = import_re.match(line)
            if m:
                imps.append(m.group(1))
    # keep only imports within our package namespace for reachability graph
    aj_imps = [i for i in imps if i == PKG_PREFIX or i.startswith(PKG_PREFIX + ".")]
    imports[mod] = aj_imps
    all_imports_seen[mod] = imps

# dangling imports: AlgebraicJacobian.* imports that don't correspond to an existing module file
dangling = []
for mod, imps in imports.items():
    for i in imps:
        if i not in all_modules:
            dangling.append((mod, i))

# BFS/DFS reachability from ROOT_MODULE
if ROOT_MODULE not in all_modules:
    print(f"WARNING: root module {ROOT_MODULE} not found in all_modules set!")

visited = set()
order = []
queue = deque([ROOT_MODULE])
visited.add(ROOT_MODULE)
while queue:
    cur = queue.popleft()
    order.append(cur)
    for nxt in imports.get(cur, []):
        if nxt not in visited:
            visited.add(nxt)

reachable = visited & all_modules

unrooted = all_modules - reachable

# cycle detection via DFS on the whole graph (imports edges), restricted to nodes in all_modules

cycles = []

    color[u] = 1
    stack.append(u)
    for v in imports.get(u, []):
        if v not in all_modules:
            continue
        if color[v] == 1:
            # found a cycle; extract the cycle path
            idx = stack.index(v)
            cycles.append(stack[idx:] + [v])
        elif color[v] == 0:
            dfs(v, stack)
    stack.pop()
    color[u] = 2

    "dangling_imports": sorted(set(dangling)),

    "num_cycles": len(cycles),
